==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] bacon [[Cookbook:Drippings|drippings]] or [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] of [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] chunks
* 1½ tablespoons [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1½ tablespoons [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1½ tablespoons dry [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] water
* 2–3 bottles [[Cookbook:Chili Paste|chili sauce]] 
* 1 dash of tobacco (optional)

== Special equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Slow Cooker|Slow cooker]]

==Procedure==
# Add the bacon drippings/vegetable oil to a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over high heat. Add the beef to the skillet, and brown the meat on all sides. Do not cook completely through. Transfer meat to the slow cooker.
# In a skillet, melt the butter. Add the onions, and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] until they begin to become transparent.
# Combine all the ingredients except the meat in the skillet. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 10 minutes.
# Combine all ingredients in a [[Cookbook:Slow Cooker|slow cooker]]. Stir together. 
# Cook on low for 2½–3½ hours.
# Serve with mashed potatoes and honey carrots.
